messages.subject: Bioc-teaching meeting: Monday, August 17, 1pm CEST
parts:
Dear all,

Short reminder about next monday's meeting.

Here are the final points of last meeting's notes [1]:

  1. How can we measure success?

  2. How to certify new people to help us teach, and to grow the community?

  3. How can we leverage the current momentum to start building something tangible? Start a GitHub repository?

  4. How can we benefit from teaching material that we already have (developed for other courses)?

  5. Is there Interest in a train the trainers course? 

Best wishes,

Laurent


[1] https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing

messages.subject: Bioc-teaching meeting: Monday, October 12, 2pm CEST
parts:
Hi everyone, 

just a quick reminder about the bioc-teaching call today at 2pm CEST. The main agenda point today is to formulate the learning objectives for the initial lessons, to simplify later addition and structuring of material. Toby will guide us through the process. 
The jitsi link is the same as last time: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you there!
Charlotte & Laurent

messages.author: 4a919e2a7108f363
messages.subject: Upcoming Bioc-teaching calls
parts:
Hi all,

just an early heads-up that since the December Bioc-teaching call overlaps with the opening of EuroBioc, we would like to move it one week earlier, that is, to December 7 (same time, 2pm CET). The November call will take place as planned on November 9. Hope this works for everyone.

Thanks,
Charlotte & Laurent
